description: Run Magist’s deterministic engine for a product (features, markets, audience age bands, optional business model) and return regulations and Controls that may apply, a complexity tier with a numeric score, a `blockerCount` (the `blocker` tier, shown to readers as "Before launch"), and a per-audience breakdown. May create a public report URL; identical reports are reused without renewal; links expire 90 days after first write and may be withheld. The same inputs produce the same output on the same corpus and engine, with no LLM in the path. firstEffectiveDate is a Control’s earliest admitted date, null when unknown, and may be in the future. deferredControlReferences, present only when an embargo with a stamped as-of date withholds dated pairs from applicableControls, cannot appear here: these inputs accept no as-of date. Returns which obligations may apply for research purposes; it is not a determination that they do apply, and does not replace counsel. Consult a licensed attorney before relying on the result.

audiences.description: Audience age bands. Exactly these three ids exist.

businessModel.description: Optional business-model context (role, participants, transactionInvolvement, dataHandling). Validated server-side with the /api/compute-requirements allowlist.

features.description: Product feature ids from the closed catalog, e.g. ["account-creation","text-chat","iap","ai-content-gen"]. Call list_feature_catalog for all valid ids; unknown ids are rejected with an actionable error.

markets.description: Target market codes, e.g. ["eu","us","california","uk"]. Call list_feature_catalog for all valid ids; unknown ids are rejected with an actionable error.

name: compute_requirements
title: Compute regulatory requirements
